pages.title: Deletective — A free online party game with friends
pages.description: Read the reactions. Invent the deleted message. Make your friends lose it. A free browser game for 2–10 players, with a daily solo challenge.

pages.title: A free 2-player browser game — Play Deletective Duo
pages.description: A creative online game designed for exactly two friends. Invent the deleted message, reveal your answers together, and react. Free, no account or download.
h1: Your friend is a terrible influence. Perfect.

pages.title: A funny online game for couples — Deletective date night
pages.description: Play a free creative date-night game from separate phones. Invent missing messages in fictional first dates, family dinners, and vacation disasters. No relationship quizzes.
h1: Date night, with a plot twist.

pages.title: Free online party game for 3–10 friends — Deletective
pages.description: Play a text-based browser party game with your group. Secret answers, anonymous reveals, fair voting, and a Reaction Chain mode. No login or download.
h1: The whole gang has some explaining to do.

pages.title: Daily deleted-message challenge — Deletective
pages.description: A fresh fictional group chat every day. Invent the missing message, see another interpretation, and build a local streak. Free solo creative game, no login.

pages.title: How to play Deletective — Rules, modes, and scoring
pages.description: Learn Deletective in a minute: read a fictional conversation, write the missing message in secret, reveal, react, and vote with friends. Rules for every mode.
h1: A deleted message. You fill in the rest.

pages.title: About Deletective — Fictional chats, shared imagination
pages.description: Meet the idea behind Deletective: a free creative browser game about inventing missing messages with your friends, partner, or group.
h1: Every deleted message has a ridiculous story.

pages.title: Deletective FAQ — Players, privacy, devices, and rules
pages.description: Answers about playing Deletective with two people, couples, or a group; mobile support, private rooms, scoring, sharing, and the daily challenge.

pages.title: Privacy — Deletective
pages.description: How Deletective handles private rooms, guest credentials, temporary player content, local daily streaks, and optional sharing.

pages.title: Terms of play — Deletective
pages.description: Prelaunch rules for using Deletective: respectful play, fictional content, private room access, optional sharing, and service availability.

pages.title: Play Deletective — Create or join a private game room
pages.description: Create a private Deletective room or join your friends with a code. Play Duo, Couples, Party, or Reaction Chain. No sign-up, no download.

pages.description: A private Deletective game with your friends. Room content is temporary and is not published.
